title: Professional Certificate Course in Competency-Based Interviews with Effective Questioning
description: Enhance your interviewing expertise with "Competency-Based Interviews with Effective Questioning."
longDescription: Familiarise with employment laws relevant to interviewing candidates. Comprehend the purpose and benefits of competency-based interviews. Define required competencies and develop job and candidate specifications. Devise a rating system and scoring sheets for evaluating candidates. Prepare competency-based interview questions to assess specific skills. Utilize effective questioning and listening techniques during interviews. Overcome common challenges encountered in the interview process. Effectively applying competency-based interview techniques, including defining required competencies. Navigate the intricate world of competency-based interviewing. Demystify legal aspects, define essential skills, develop insightful questions, and evaluate candidates effectively, ensuring success in attracting the right talent. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following,
courseDetails: Participants will familiarize themselves with relevant employment laws, comprehend the purpose and benefits of competency-based interviews, and define job and candidate specifications. The course details include devising rating systems, preparing targeted questions, and utilizing effective questioning and listening techniques to assess specific skills. It also addresses overcoming common challenges encountered in the interview process and the effective application of competency-based interview techniques.
